userStories.title: 90-day baseline excludes current week
acceptanceCriteria: Baseline mean for each dim and signal is computed over the trailing 90 days, excluding the current ISO week
Baseline values are exposed alongside this week's values to the renderer
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Last-week panel only after 2+ weeks of data
acceptanceCriteria: Last-week mean is computed and exposed only when the user has at least 2 distinct weeks of data
When unavailable, the field is None and the renderer omits it
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Significance gating below 0.3
acceptanceCriteria: Deltas with absolute value < 0.3 on a /10 scale are tagged as `unchanged` and surfaced to the renderer as ~
Deltas with absolute value >= 0.3 are tagged with direction (up/down)
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Baseline-forming message under 14 days of data
acceptanceCriteria: When the user has fewer than 14 days of data, baseline values are returned as `--`
A flag is set so the renderer shows 'Baseline forming. Come back in 2 more weeks for week-over-week.'
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Outlier clipping for baseline contributions
acceptanceCriteria: Each session's overall is clipped to [1.0, 9.0] before contributing to the baseline
All sessions are weighted equally regardless of length when computing the baseline
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
